name: TJWA_TC_FYRT_UI_005 - [Boundary] New Tractor search with zero filters selected still lands on a valid listing page
fullName: TJWA_TC_FYRT_UI_005 - [Boundary] New Tractor search with zero filters selected still lands on a valid listing page
description:
[Boundary] Verify clicking Search on the New Tractor tab with no HP/brand selected navigates to a valid, unfiltered new tractor listing page rather than erroring.

Expected: Page loads with HTTP 200 and the expected results heading — no crash or blank page for the zero-filter edge case.
